versions.content: When Mirror_StopSourceNetwork is called to stop a LIN source bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall call LinIf_EnableBusMirroring with MirroringActive set to FALSE to stop reporting of received and transmitted LIN frames from that bus.

When Mirror_StopSourceNetwork is called to stop a LIN source bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall call LinIf_EnableBusMirroring with MirroringActive set to FALSE to stop reporting of received and transmitted LIN frames from that bus.
